frozen_original.policy: No alteration of original thresholds, original veto, source qualification or baseline masks. Original C sealed.

audit: Reconstruct every individual Boolean from archived pass1, including stationarity, wide support, fit consensus, exact stationary rival agreement, crossfit floor/margin, ON ceiling, OFF floor, OFF-ON margin, near/wide floor and margin, provenance. Separate not-applicable from failed. Compare conjunction to archived D4. Summarize marginal pass/fail/missing, cumulative fixed order, leave-one-out, cofail pairs, fit/audit, parent/rescue, eval/shared. Labels used only after operator for descriptive audit, no threshold sweep or tuning.
transition: Every archived candidate with valid native path and D5 qualified source is eligible for advisory second turn regardless of primary score, lane, stationarity, rival disagreement, or previous provisional conclusion. Ineligible retains exact archived history. Repeat only disjoint physical scans with identical signed native grid, same original source, role, time and mapped slice checks. Validate archived primary trace against fresh replay. Original decision unchanged even if arithmetic conjunction would hypothetically pass.
repeat: Preserve both original independently half-selected alternative paths separately, candidate path and near/wide measured contrasts on second ON/OFF. For drifting paths use shape replay at same native channels as descriptive fixed receiver-frame hypothesis, explicitly NOT time extrapolation or physical identity; stationarity not needed for advisory. Each path is kept fixed, no selection on second scan. Compare primary/repeat both half blocks and preserve disagreement. D1 per-path temporal blocks, D2 ON/OFF, D3 narrow/wide, D4 alternatives evidence vector, D5 provenance hashes. Append to original content-addressed trace preserving ancestry, detect no-information-gain by content. No counterfactual labels used in operator. No suppression, no recovery, no training, no Penrose. Evaluate all 11 viewed groups, 3168 rows, 176 tiles. Run 11 standalone reacquisitions; compare exact original baseline metrics/masks and all archived traces. Count actual full cost, operator runtime and extra bytes, per-group checkpoint. Stress evaluation original 119 supported audit trials preserved unchanged; advisory replay only normal candidates, no new stress claim.
gate: Archive integrity + exact original baseline/trace parity + 100% advisory transition for qualified candidates + source invalidation and nonmutating selftest + zero decision changes. Scientific claim ceiling descriptive only, no novel evidence of transmitter identity or false-alert reduction. R41S1C may use diagnostic findings only via separate preregistration and fresh held-out controls; B/D HOLD until a meaningful C is established.
